name: Roborock Saros 20 Flow
description: Roborock's just-launched Saros flagship, named for its SpiraFlow 2.0 pressurized roller-mop wash system. Pairs a retracting LiDAR turret with an AdaptiLift chassis that climbs double-layer thresholds up to 3.46" despite an ultra-slim body. Launched in the US on September 14, 2026.

This model launched just days before this page was written — noise level (dB), exact runtime in minutes, and exact dustbin/water-tank capacities are not published by Roborock and were not found in press coverage checked. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: Launch price **$1,499.99** through roughly September 20, 2026, reverting to a **$1,699.99** MSRP afterward. Launched in the US on September 14, 2026, following an IFA 2026 announcement; a Canada launch is planned for October 2026.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: SpiraFlow 2.0 self-cleaning roller-mop uses 16 water outlets at up to 15N pressure and 240 RPM, extending 44mm into corners and auto-lifting 15mm on carpet. Navigation pairs retractable RetractSense LiDAR with structured-light and RGB-camera AI recognizing 300+ obstacles. The AdaptiLift Traverse 3.0 chassis lets an 8.98cm-tall body climb thresholds up to 8.8cm. RockDock handles auto-empty, water refill, mop washing, drying.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: The Saros 20 Flow's SpiraFlow 2.0 system runs 16 pressurized water outlets continuously across a self-cleaning roller mop at up to 240 RPM, a notably more elaborate wet-cleaning setup than the spinning mop pads on most competing robot vacuums. Its chassis also lets the robot climb double-layer thresholds up to 3.46 inches despite an ultra-slim profile.

firmwareCommunity.note: Roborock Saros 20 Flow has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
